rationale: The first reply was long and generic, mixing in gas and US-style advice (broil, breaker, self-clean). After the customer gave the Neff, flashing 0.00 and power cut, the assistant correctly identified the power cut and clock reset as the cause and gave sensible steps for setting the clock and clearing the symbol. The oven then worked, with no parts and no unsafe instructions. Minor weakness: the breaker off/on suggestion was only a fallback, and the first message carried some irrelevant content.
